pages.text: Mowzie's Mobs bosses stay where they are born and defend a place. Each has its own rules; the structure tells you the rules before the fight does.$(br2)Ferrous Wroughtnaut and Naga are $(l:patchouli:tech/tier2)Tier 2$(); Umvuthi is Tier 2; Frostmaw is $(l:patchouli:tech/tier3)Tier 3$().
Ferrous Wroughtnaut: an armoured knight in a chamber under the ground. Only its back is weak, and only after it swings. Patience, not damage. Holds $(bold)Trains$().
Naga: coastal cliff flyers that spit acid and dive. Shoot them while they hover; they land when hurt. Holds $(bold)Ships$().
Umvuthi: the sun chief of an Umvuthana grove in the savanna. His followers come first; he fights with solar fire. Holds $(bold)Diesel$().
Frostmaw: a sleeping giant on an ice crystal in the snow. Wake it and it charges, freezes, slams. Warm clothes and a wall to hide behind. Holds $(bold)Cannons$().
The Sculptor on the peaks is not a fight but a test of climbing. Pass it and it gives a tool. Not on the ladder, worth the climb.
